items.html: And the matter is that from these 288 sparks of the kings who died and descended into the world of Beria — when the correction of the eighth king, Hadar, came, he began to sort from them the sparks and the vessels as well; and all that he sorted from them was only the parts of the Nukva in all the Partzufim [pl. of Partzuf]. And at first the most sorted, the choicest, and the finest of them all was sorted, and it rose into Atzilut.
